issue.title: Surface @file capture targets and sidecar visibility in launch-approval preview
issue.description: Surface @file capture targets and sidecar visibility in the launch-approval preview, which needs a host-side resolve-only pass because the preview is built before the agent process starts. Proposed by sase-js.5 (The @file ref and the content-addressed store) during landing of epic sase-js (Artifact reference contract).
